Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release ext.passthrough: inline child jobs (the child pipeline ci/release.yml runs inline as jobs release-created, release-publish; the job release-created fails when the workflow rules of the child pipeline do not create it, as GitLab fails the trigger job, and every job that needs the call waits for it; a variable that a run sets by hand reads as unset in the child conditions, as GitLab does not forward it without forward:pipeline_variables, but its value can reach the scripts of the child jobs; a return to GitLab restores the call and the child file only with the round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/fail step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/pass step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-publish job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-publish/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-created/step/fail step.if: step when (on a pull request Drone matches the branch filter against the target branch, so the condition also holds on a pull request that targets the branch; the source may not)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/release-publish job.if: pipeline trigger conditions (on a pull request Drone matches the branch filter against the target branch, so the condition leaves pull requests out, as a branch test of a GitLab merge request pipeline does)
